metadata.title: Zscaler ASIM Incident Response
metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel incident-triggered Consumption Logic App that enriches an incident with ASIM-normalized network/web session context, requests explicit analyst approval over Microsoft Teams, and - only after approval - blocks the approved IP and URL entities in Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) through the Zscaler OneAPI OAuth2 gateway. Zscaler OAuth2 credentials are stored in and retrieved from Azure Key Vault via the playbook's managed identity; no secrets are stored in this template.
prerequisites: Deploy this template with WorkflowState left as Disabled (the default). Do not enable the workflow until every prerequisite below is complete.

Create (or reuse) an Azure Key Vault with soft delete and purge protection enabled. Store three secrets in it out-of-band: the Zscaler OneAPI OAuth2 client ID, the OAuth2 client secret, and the full OAuth2 token URL (for example https://<vanity-domain>.zslogin.net/oauth2/v1/token). Never place these values in this template, a parameters file, or source control.

Grant the deployed Logic App's system-assigned managed identity the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role (or an equivalent least-privilege role) scoped to that Key Vault, and the 'Log Analytics Reader' role scoped to the target Log Analytics workspace. This template intentionally does not create role assignments or automation rules; the surrounding infrastructure deployment owns RBAC and automation-rule wiring.
In the Zscaler OneAPI / ZIA admin console, create an OAuth2 API client authorized for the URL/IP category management and status-activation endpoints used by this playbook.

Authorize the Microsoft Teams API connection exactly once after deployment: open the 'teams' connection resource in the Azure portal (or Logic App designer) and complete interactive sign-in/consent for the account that will post and respond to the approval adaptive card. This delegated consent step cannot be automated by an ARM template.

Confirm the Microsoft Sentinel API connection (already configured for managed identity by this template) resolves correctly, and that the Logic App's managed identity has the Microsoft Sentinel Responder role assigned by the surrounding infrastructure deployment.
Only after the previous steps are verified, set WorkflowState to Enabled (or update the deployed resource's state) and attach this playbook to an incident-creation automation rule.

metadata.description: Name of the Logic App (playbook) resource.
Name of the Microsoft Sentinel API connection resource used by this playbook (managed identity authentication).
Name of the Microsoft Teams API connection resource used by this playbook. Requires a one-time interactive authorization after deployment; see README.md.
Deployed state of the Logic App. Must remain Disabled until connections, RBAC and Key Vault secrets are configured; see README.md.
Customer ID (workspace GUID) of the target Log Analytics workspace that ASIM-normalized data is queried from.
Base vault URI of the Azure Key Vault holding the Zscaler OneAPI OAuth2 credentials, for example https://<vault-name>.vault.azure.net. No trailing slash required.
Name of the Key Vault secret holding the Zscaler OneAPI OAuth2 client ID.
Name of the Key Vault secret holding the Zscaler OneAPI OAuth2 client secret.
Name of the Key Vault secret holding the full Zscaler OneAPI OAuth2 token URL, for example https://<vanity-domain>.zslogin.net/oauth2/v1/token.
Base URI of the Zscaler OneAPI gateway used for ZIA URL/IP category and activation calls. This is a public API endpoint, not a secret.
Name of the Zscaler ZIA URL category that approved IP and URL entities are added to for blocking.
User principal name (email) of the analyst who receives the Microsoft Teams adaptive card and must explicitly approve or reject the block action.
ISO 8601 duration the playbook waits for an explicit analyst decision on the Teams adaptive card before treating the incident as not approved, for example PT8H.
Number of days of history to include when querying ASIM-normalized tables for context on the extracted IP and URL entities.
Maximum number of rows returned by the ASIM context query per normalized table.

body.message: Zscaler ASIM Incident Response: this incident already carries the idempotency label for the configured block category. Skipping duplicate execution to avoid repeating the block/activation workflow.

inputs.name: AsimContextSummary
inputs.value: @{concat('Returned ', string(length(coalesce(body('HTTP_Query_ASIM_Context')?['tables']?[0]?['rows'], createArray()))), ' ASIM row(s) across _Im_WebSession, _Im_NetworkSession and _Im_Dns for the last ', string(parameters('AsimTimeRangeDays')), ' day(s).')}

inputs.name: AsimContextSummary
inputs.value: @{concat('ASIM context query did not complete successfully (status ', string(coalesce(outputs('HTTP_Query_ASIM_Context')?['statusCode'], 'unknown')), '). Continuing without enrichment context.')}

body.message:
@{concat('

Zscaler ASIM Incident Response - enrichment:
Candidate IP(s): ', join(variables('CandidateIPs'), ', '), '
Candidate URL(s): ', join(variables('CandidateUrls'), ', '), '
ASIM context: ', variables('AsimContextSummary'), '
Each candidate entity below will be presented for individual analyst approval - no entity will be blocked in bulk.

')}

body.text: Zscaler ASIM Incident Response - approval requested for one entity
@{concat('Total candidate entities extracted from this incident: ', string(length(variables('AllCandidates'))))}

@{if(equals(coalesce(item()?['Type'], ''), 'IP'), 'Caution: this is an IP address entity extracted from the incident. IP entities on a Sentinel incident may represent a source, client, internal, or victim IP address rather than a confirmed malicious host - verify the role of this exact IP using the ASIM context and the incident itself before approving a block.', 'Caution: verify this exact URL using the ASIM context and the incident itself before approving a block.')}
Approve blocking THIS entity in Zscaler ZIA?

inputs.name: RejectedEntitySummaryLines
inputs.value: @{concat(coalesce(item()?['Type'], 'Unknown'), ': ', coalesce(item()?['Value'], 'Unknown'), ' - not approved (rejected or approval window expired)')}

body.message:
@{concat('

Zscaler ASIM Incident Response: analyst ', parameters('ApproverUpn'), ' approved blocking the following entities in Zscaler ZIA category ', parameters('BlockCategory'), ', and the change was activated:

', outputs('Compose_Blocked_Summary_Html'))}

@{concat('

Zscaler ASIM Incident Response: entities were added to category ', parameters('BlockCategory'), ' but the Zscaler activation call failed (status ', string(coalesce(outputs('Zscaler_Activate_Changes')?['statusCode'], 'unknown')), '). Manual activation in ZIA is required.

')}

runError.message: Zscaler ZIA activation call did not return a 2xx status.

body.message:
@{concat('

Zscaler ASIM Incident Response: the request to add approved entities to Zscaler ZIA category ', parameters('BlockCategory'), ' failed (status ', string(coalesce(outputs('Zscaler_Add_Entities_To_Category')?['statusCode'], 'unknown')), '). No changes were activated.

')}

runError.message: Zscaler ZIA add-to-category call did not return a 2xx status.

body.message: Zscaler ASIM Incident Response: the Zscaler OneAPI OAuth2 token request failed or returned no access token. No block was applied. Verify the Key Vault secrets and Zscaler OneAPI client configuration.

runError.message: Zscaler OneAPI OAuth2 token request did not succeed.

body.message: Zscaler ASIM Incident Response: one or more Key Vault secret retrievals for the Zscaler OneAPI credentials failed. No block was applied. Verify the playbook's managed identity has 'Key Vault Secrets User' access and that the configured secret names exist.

runError.message: One or more Zscaler OneAPI credential secrets could not be retrieved from Key Vault.

body.message:
@{concat('

Zscaler ASIM Incident Response: no candidate entity was explicitly approved by ', parameters('ApproverUpn'), '. Every candidate was either rejected or the approval window expired before a decision was received. No Key Vault secrets were retrieved, no Zscaler OneAPI calls were made, and no idempotency marker was written, so this incident remains eligible for a later retry.

', if(greater(length(coalesce(variables('RejectedEntitySummaryLines'), createArray())), 0), concat('
  • ', join(variables('RejectedEntitySummaryLines'), '
  • '), '
'), ''))}
Zscaler ASIM Incident Response: no IP or URL entities were found on this incident. No enrichment, approval request, or block action was performed.
